The Mandatory Sentimental Part

A Letter for Min

Dear Min,

Tomorrow is 29 years. That is longer than a good number of the world's current governments have been in charge. (I checked.)

It has gone fast. You made it easy, mostly by being patient and willing to overlook a lot.

"Declassified: I would do all 29 years again without changing a thing. Okay, a few things. But not you. Never you."

Here's to year 30, and wherever we go next. I'll check Seerist. You pick the restaurants.

Still yours (no take-backs),

With All My Love ❤️
